script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

---

INT. MCCORMICK KITCHEN - MORNING

MRS. MCCORMICK, 50s, a warm and loving mother, is making breakfast for her two children, JACK, 13, a curious and creative boy, and JESSICA, 11, a kind and thoughtful girl.

JACK
(looking at the recipe book)
Mom, today's the day we make the famous "Galactic Pancakes"!

MRS. MCCORMICK
(smiling)
I forgot about that, Jack. You really are quite the inventor.

JESSICA
(excited)
Can I help, Mom?

MRS. MCCORMICK
(nodding)
Of course, Jessica. Let's work together on these.

INT. LIVING ROOM - AFTERNOON

Jack and Jessica are on the floor, building a spaceship made out of cardboard boxes, duct tape, and plastic containers.

JACK
(putting on a helmet made of a pot and tin foil)
Alright, Captain Jessica, we're ready for our first space mission!

JESSICA
(giggling)
This cardboard spaceship won't get us very far, Jack. Maybe we should try building something more realistic next time.

JACK
(proudly)
But this is our spaceship, Jessica. It's not about reality; it's about imagination!

INT. McCORMICK DINING ROOM - NIGHT

The family sits down for dinner. Jack and Jessica tell their father, MR. MCCORMICK, 50s, a hardworking and caring father, about their Galactic Pancakes and their space missions.

MR. MCCORMICK
(laughing)
You two always know how to put a smile on my face.

MRS. MCCORMICK
(smiling)
You're just as imaginative as your children, dear.

INT. McCORMICK BACKYARD - DAY

Jack and Jessica are planting flowers and vegetables in their backyard garden. They talk about their dreams, ambitions, and their love for nature.

JACK
(picking up a flower)
When I grow up, I want to be an astronaut and discover new worlds.

JESSICA
(holding a seed)
But I want to be a botanist and help protect the environment.

JACK
(smiling)
We'll both make a difference in the world, Jessica.

INT. McCORMICK LIVING ROOM - EVENING

Jack and Jessica watch an astronomy documentary, snuggled under a blanket, sharing a bag of popcorn.

JACK
(looking up at the night sky)
One day, I'll be up there, Jessica. I'll look back down at this world and remember our space missions.

JESSICA
(holding his hand)
I'll be here, waiting for you. And our friendship will reach the stars.

INT. McCORMICK KITCHEN - MORNING

Mrs. McCormick is making breakfast once again. Jack and Jessica enter the kitchen, excited for the day ahead.

JACK
(grinning)
Good morning, Mom! Another day of adventures!

MRS. MCCORMICK
(laughing)
Indeed, my dear. May your friendship reach the stars and beyond.

---

End of screenplay.
